newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Komi region plans $30 mln bond by Mar 31.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Komi region plans $30 mln bond by Mar 31.

text.p: Russia's northern Komi Republic plans to issue a $30 million bond by March 31, Komi's Deputy Economy Minister Sergei Frolov said on Thursday.
He told Reuters that the bond would be a five-year paper and pay interest similar to that of Russia's sovereign Eurobond.
Komi Finance Ministry securities department head Galina Yudina said the borrowing could be done in the form of a credit.
"We are working on four options for placement and it is difficult to say which one will be chosen," she said.
Komi has already done two bond issues. It raised seven billion roubles in 1995 and nine billion roubles in 1996 to finance the People's Telephone programme through one-year bonds.
The northern republic placed six-year municipal housing bonds worth 20 billion roubles in 1994.
